spans.claim: The packet contains peace terms formulated by the Socialist and Labour parties of Germany
spans.anchor: that packet which is responsible for your incarceration here

spans.claim: The peace proposals bear the signatures of the Kaiser, the Chancellor and Hindenburg
spans.anchor: the three great men of Germany, whose signatures are attached to that document
spans.span: by the three great men of Germany, whose signatures are attached to that document--the Kaiser, the Chancellor and Hindenburg.

spans.claim: Nicholas Fenn is the secretary of the Labour Council and involved in secret communications
spans.anchor: Nicholas Fenn, the Labour M.P.?
spans.span: Nicholas Fenn, the Labour M.P.?" "That's the fellow.

spans.claim: Julian Orden is the anonymous writer Paul Fiske
spans.anchor: Julian Orden comes here as the representative of the new Labour Council
spans.span: to learn that our friend Julian Orden comes here as the representative of the new Labour Council.

spans.claim: Fenn claims to have received letters from Freistner and has destroyed originals
spans.anchor: I never keep a communication from Freistner. I have told you so before
spans.span: I never keep a communication from Freistner. I have told you so before.

spans.claim: Fenn has received German money and is bribed
spans.anchor: Nicholas Fenn has had a hundred thousand pounds of German money within the last few months
spans.span: Nicholas Fenn has had a hundred thousand pounds of German money within the last few months," she replied.

spans.claim: The originals of Freistner’s communications have been destroyed
spans.anchor: It seems that the originals of most of Freistner’s communications have been destroyed

spans.claim: Julian Orden was incapacitated by gas and held by Fenn and Bright
spans.anchor: He has spent the intervening period, until three o’clock this afternoon, in a small laboratory
spans.span: He has spent the intervening period, until three o'clock this afternoon, in a small laboratory attached to the premises.

spans.claim: The Labour Council threatens a general strike if the armistice is refused
spans.anchor: Those twenty will unanimously proclaim a general strike, if you should refuse the proposed armistice
spans.span: Those twenty will unanimously proclaim a general strike, if you should refuse the proposed armistice.

spans.claim: The Prime Minister refuses the peace proposals citing dishonour
spans.anchor: I cannot ask for the armistice you suggest
spans.span: I cannot ask for the armistice you suggest.

spans.claim: Catherine Abbeway warns Julian of the deception and presents proof
spans.anchor: Thank God we are in time to stop them!
spans.span: Thank God we are in time to stop them!" Julian looked at her for a moment, utterly incredulous.

spans.claim: Fenn collapses when accused of lying and bribery
spans.anchor: Fenn sprang to his feet. He had all the appearance of a man about to make a vigorous and exhaustive defence
spans.span: Fenn sprang to his feet. He had all the appearance of a man about to make a vigorous and exhaustive defence.

spans.claim: Julian Orden is elected as the Labour Council’s envoy
spans.anchor: Mr. Julian Orden, better known to you all under the name of ‘Paul Fiske’, has been chosen

spans.claim: The Council destroys all traces of the deception to protect the cause
spans.anchor: It rests with every one of you to destroy all the traces of what might have happened
spans.span: It rests with every one of you to destroy all the traces of what might have happened.

spans.claim: The Baron Hellman is a German agent involved in the plot
spans.anchor: There was a young foreigner, some weeks ago, a Baron Hellman

spans.claim: The peace proposals are a cunning German plot to deceive the Allies
spans.anchor: The supposed strength of the Socialist Party in Germany is an utter sham
spans.span: The supposed strength of the Socialist Party in Germany is an utter sham.

spans.claim: The Labour Council’s power to paralyse industry is real and threatening
spans.anchor: Within a few hours to paralyse industrial England, to keep her ships idle in the docks
spans.span: Under their fingers grew the more amplified mandates which, following upon the bombshell of the already prepared telegrams, were within a few hours to paralyse industrial England, to keep her ships idle in the docks, her trains motionless upon the rails, her mines silent, her forges cold, her great factories empty.

spans.claim: Fenn’s financial records reveal his betrayal
spans.anchor: Your bank book, as you only received your last instalment from Germany this week

spans.claim: The Prime Minister warns of the consequences of the Labour Council’s threat
spans.anchor: If you carry out your threat, you plunge this country into revolution
spans.span: If you carry out your threat, you plunge this country into revolution, you dishonour us in the face of our Allies; you will go through the rest of your lives, every one of you, with a guilt upon your souls, a stain upon your consciences, which nothing will ever obliterate.

spans.claim: Julian Orden and Catherine Abbeway become engaged
spans.anchor: I think that during these last few days we have forgotten to be human
spans.span: I think that during these last few days we have forgotten to be human, and it might help us--for after all, you know, we are engaged!
